title: VerificationArtifact
description: Two-pass output of the Verification judge (AGENTS.md Role 4). Pass 1 (extraction) and pass 2 (rubric_result) are separate calls by design. The model never sets status directly — deterministic code applies the confidence threshold (BLUEPRINT.md §7).

extraction.description: Pass 1 — what the artifact actually shows. Vision/LLM, structured, no verdict.

rubric_result.description: Pass 2 — deterministic checklist scored by the model against the directive's verification_spec.rubric.

status.description: Set by deterministic code from confidence vs. threshold — never written directly by the model.
